briefdescription.para: A custom context implementation to provide type-narrowing as a natural side effect of a chain of "if" conditions.

detaileddescription.para: The innermost AndIfContext is used to compile the "then" block of the multi-condition "if", while the outermost IfContext is used to compile the "else" block. This context behaves as a combination of the AndContext and IfContext.
